purpose.primary: Paper-only, time-causal DeFi / market research harness: generate or ingest events, build decision packets, label outcomes with full cost stack, walk-forward split, fit conservative baselines, plan with ABSTAIN-by-default, audit, and report — without live trading or silent online weight updates.
purpose.control_plane: Stationary + NonStationary engineers run a mandatory double-pass on data and code before anything is cleared for LLM interpretation or further promotion.
purpose.knowledge_plane: Finite settled facts, physics/math atlas (with OPEN gaps), constants, RAG digests, and coverage maximizer — for verification support, not a complete world oracle.

does: Synthetic market event generation (or adapters for real normalized events)
Outcome labeling with net-PnL identity checks
Double-pass verification (schema, causality, accounting, claims, etc.)
Adversarial / fuzz regression of the gates
Audits, reports, ledgers, optional merkle / knowledge report
Offline promotion of human-confirmed settled facts
does_not: Complete physics or all human knowledge
Unsupervised online model weight updates mid-replay

inputs: Normalized event streams (parquet/JSONL) via ingest adapters if provided
Optional read-only chain observer (disabled live RPC by default)
internal: megacompact16.core — AMM, quote/execution/cost/outcome engines, baseline, audits
knowledge_facade — atlas + KSKB + constants + rag + coverage
smt_gate / interval_arith / typed_ir / causal_graph — pre-TRADE mechanical checks
promotion + ledgers — offline knowledge growth and provenance
outputs: artifacts/run_*/ data, splits, audits, reports, verification ledgers
optional_external: Lean/Coq via formal_bridge (unchecked until kernel accepts)
scikit-learn / FAISS / FastAPI if present (core degrades gracefully without them)

one_sentence: It is a fail-closed research pipeline that turns market-like data into audited, time-causal decision experiments and only then may hand cleared artifacts to an LLM — hooked to local artifacts, optional readonly data feeds, and mechanical verifiers, not to live trading.
